privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: Drape ("we", "our") is a mobile integrated development environment (IDE) that lets you create, edit, and manage software projects directly from your device. This notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
When you create an account, we collect:
• Data about created projects (name, type, configuration)
• Interaction logs with the AI assistant (prompts and responses)

Subscription payments are handled entirely by Apple through In-App Purchase. We do not collect or store credit card or financial information. We only receive the transaction identifier from Apple to verify subscription status.
• Provide and maintain the Drape service
• Process requests to the AI assistant
• Send push notifications (if enabled) about your project status
• Improve the service and fix errors
Data is stored on Google infrastructure compliant with GDPR.
Requests to the AI assistant are processed by AI providers. Prompts are sent in anonymized form, without direct association to your account.
Apple handles all payments. See Apple's privacy policy for details about payment-data handling.
Account data is retained as long as your account remains active. Project data is retained for the lifetime of the project. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
• Data access limited to the account owner
• Isolated execution environment for each project (Docker containers)
• Request deletion of your account and associated data
To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below.
Drape is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
We reserve the right to update this notice. Significant changes will be communicated through the app.

To use Drape you must create an account. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential.
For security reasons, your account can be active on only one device at a time. Signing in from a new device ends the active session.
You retain ownership of all code and content you create through Drape. You are responsible for the content you upload and the projects you create.
Drape offers different plans: Starter (free), Go, and Pro. Features and limits for each plan are described in the app.
• Payments are handled through Apple In-App Purchase
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at purchase confirmation
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The renewal cost is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings after purchase
Refunds are handled by Apple according to its policies. You can request a refund via reportaproblem.apple.com.
Each plan includes a monthly AI budget. Usage is tracked and resets monthly.
The AI assistant generates suggestions and code. You are responsible for reviewing and using generated content. We do not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of AI responses.

We aim to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. Maintenance or updates may cause temporary interruptions.
Drape is provided "as is". We are not liable for:
• Loss of data or code due to malfunctions

Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the subscription in the previous 12 months.
We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. You can delete your account at any time from the app settings.
We reserve the right to modify these terms. Significant changes will be communicated through the app with at least 30 days' notice.
